evidence_items.claim: SMBC is a clearing member of JSCC (Japan Securities Clearing Corporation), which launched CDM-based reporting in production in June 2025
evidence_items.excerpt: JSCC is the first CCP globally to deploy CDM in production. SMBC as a major Japanese clearing member is connected to this CDM infrastructure.
evidence_items.caveats: JSCC CDM adoption does not necessarily indicate SMBC internal CDM strategy. Clearing members can interface through vendor solutions.

null_results.implication: No public announcements of CDM adoption. Suggests relying on vendor/infrastructure solutions without native build.
No open source contributions to CDM projects.

classification.rationale: Classified OBSERVER (CCP-Connected) based on indirect connection to JSCC CDM infrastructure. No direct bank-level CDM implementation evidence.
